messages:
marta: FYI product is deprecating the v1/models endpoint on 2026-05-15. We need a concise migration guide, updated SDK snippets (TS + Py), and a redirect map for old docs links. Who can pick this up?

sahil: I can own the migration guide and the SDK snippets. Quick question — do we need sample requests showing streaming behavior change?

marta: yes please include streaming example and the new error semantics. Also add a short note about model aliasing when swapping embed models. Keep it <500 words.

lex: for embed swaps i'll update the "embeddings.md" section. heads-up: the new v2 embed model has different dims, callouts required for downstream indexers.

olivia: i'll do the redirect map and the actual website redirects (nextjs rewrites). i'll open a PR to platform/docs-website with the redirects and the canonical example update.

sahil: plan for PRs — I'll split into: 1) migration guide draft, 2) SDK snippet changes in the sdk-examples repo, 3) quickstart update. ETA for first draft: Wed EOD (2 days). OK?

marta: sounds good. olivia, can you coordinate with infra for a staging deploy so we can smoke-test the redirects and canonical examples? Need staging up before Thurs.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z for docs-website PR #412

olivia: noted. i'll ping infra and flag the PR for a quick preview deploy. also i'll include the redirect JSON like this in the PR:

```json
[
  {"from":"/v1/models","to":"/v2/models","status":301},
  {"from":"/docs/api/models#v1","to":"/docs/api/models#v2","status":302}
]
```

marta: Great. Small ops ask: can we add a checklist comment at the top of each PR with these items: author, review owner (marta), smoke-test steps, and a link to the rollback snippet.

sahil: adding checklist to my PRs. Also calling out tests: run snippet smoke-tests (sdk-examples/test/snippets) and a quick curl smoke test (included in PR description).

lex: FYI I'll change the embed example dims and add a note for indexers. Will mention potential model fallback implications.

marta: timeline recap — first drafts by Wed EOD, redirects PR by Thu AM, staging smoke tests Thu afternoon, final publish Thurs evening. If anyone needs time bumped shout here.

olivia: i might need an extra day on redirects if infra is slow. can we target Fri morning as a fallback?

marta: yep ok. fallback Fri morning. please @marta in the PRs so I can review fast. Thanks all :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: reminder: docs-website preview URL will be available in the PR checks once deploy completes.
